_comment: Critical surfaces that MUST reference an idempotency primitive. Scanner walks each directory; files matching excludeFilenamePatterns are skipped (models/DTOs/validators/tests aren't mutation entry points). Three levels of non-enforcement: `exceptions` (truly don't need idempotency, e.g., read-only services), `grandfatheredGaps` (known current gaps tracked as warnings — remove from list as each is fixed), and new violations (unexpected — fail CI).

_exceptionNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi: Read-only service — no mutations, no idempotency needed.

Read-only derivation service. Exports deriveStatusFromAmounts (pure fn) and deriveInvoiceStatus (findOne + aggregate → returns a status string). No updateOne / save / create / $set. Status writes happen in the callers (ledger.orchestrator.service.js, invoices.routes.js, reconciliation.service.js); conditional-update hardening belongs there, not here.

src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.reason: Read-only financial facade (queries only, no mutations)
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.justification: Header comment self-describes as 'Read-Only Facade for Financial Domain'. Exports `new FinancialReadService()`. Audit: 0 hits for .create / .save / .updateOne / .findOneAndUpdate / .deleteOne / .bulkWrite / $set / $inc / $push / $pull / $unset. 4 hits for read methods (find / findOne / aggregate / count). All state transitions that touch the financial collections live in the writer services (ledger.orchestrator, invoice, refund, quotation.orchestrator).

src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.reason: Not HTTP-invoked. Cron / webhook-driven billing generator. Function comment at L4-7: 'Called by internal cron/webhook handlers without HTTP req context. Not invoked via org-plane HTTP routes.' Signature is generateBillingInvoice(organizationId, couponCode) — no req parameter to read Idempotency-Key from.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.gap: Concurrent cron firings for the same (organizationId, billingCycleStart) can both findOne({status:'draft'}) → both get null → both BillingInvoice.create() → duplicate draft invoices.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.correctFix: Convert the create branch at L190 to atomic findOneAndUpdate with upsert + $setOnInsert on {organizationId, billingCycleStart, status:'draft'}.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.blocker: Atomic upsert requires a unique index on {organizationId, billingCycleStart} (scoped to draft state). Adding an index is prohibited without a data audit for existing multi-draft tenants.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.nextStep: Audit PlatformInvoice / BillingInvoice collection for legit multi-draft rows per (org, cycle). If none exist: add sparse unique index + switch create to atomic upsert in a single cohesive commit.

src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.reason: Uses Optimistic Aggregate Versioning (CAS via version field) on all user-driven state transitions. The `expectedVersion` parameter is threaded through every mutating method; internal-event callers set isInternalEvent=true and trust single-source-of-truth semantics.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.mechanism: updateOne({_id, version: expectedVersion}, { $set: {...}, $inc: { version: 1 } }) + VersionConflictError on modifiedCount===0 ensures only one concurrent mutation succeeds per aggregate. Verified at L393 (post-payment status transition) and L514 (void transition).
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.ledgerSafety: All 5 FinancialLedger.create sites are either (a) downstream of a successful OAV updateOne — L408 follows L393, L535 follows L514; duplicates can't reach them because the OAV guard throws VersionConflictError upstream — or (b) inside a createInvoice flow where 'duplicate' would mean two distinct invoice._ids (L212, L228), i.e. a CALLER-level retry concern addressed at HTTP routes via the IdempotencyKey middleware, not a ledger-write concern.
src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi.justification: Version-based OAV is STRICTLY STRONGER than status-based conditional updates: it catches any concurrent mutation regardless of destination state. Adding `{status: FROM}` filters on top would add noise; replacing OAV with status-based filter would regress protection (L393's newStatus is dynamically derived and can be 'paid', 'partially_paid', or 'issued' — a hardcoded FROM-status filter would be wrong there).

src/modules/billingDomain/refunds/refund.targetFix: Optionally mount Idempotency-Key middleware on POST /refunds for HTTP-level response replay (4xx/5xx included). Service layer already handles the primary dedup via refund.service.js (commit 5fff527).
src/modules/billingDomain/refunds/refund.note: Route gets opt-in idempotency via refund.service.js reading the Idempotency-Key header directly. Middleware mount is OPTIONAL — would add response-replay at the HTTP layer. Only needed if src/middleware/idempotency.middleware.js is committed.
